What I know so far:
- Invite was sent from our transactional service using a template that inlines a small tracking pixel and a second HTML part (we include an attached invite.eml for trace).

Thanks for flagging and for the reproduce steps. Quick notes from infra/eng review:

- We confirmed the transactional mailer unintentionally attaches the invite as message/rfc822 for customers that request an "attach invite" flag (that's what created the .eml attachment). When Gmail sees message/rfc822 it sometimes falls back to MHTML-like presentation.
- Mitigation (short term): disable the "attach invite" flag for outgoing invites to major procurement domains (coupa/ariba/workday) and re-send. This prevents the attached .eml from being included and keeps CTA inside primary HTML part.
- Fix (longer term): move the invite content into a single primary multipart/alternative (text + html) and ensure the CTA is not added as an attachment. PR filed: github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-mailer/pull/478 (rolls back attach flow + explicit content-type ordering).

Soojin — I can coordinate a re-send to SolarBridge once we disable the flag. Marissa — could you confirm whether we have permission to resend the invite to procurement@solarbridge.com and if re-sending requires any Do-Not-Resend check?

Emily (cc'd) — we can resend this afternoon after we flip the flag. Apologies for the extra step; we'll keep you posted.

-Ben
